title: Edge Cluster Architecture and Quorum
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Edge Cluster Architecture and Quorum.
learning_objectives: Explain edge cluster architecture and quorum using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for edge cluster architecture and quorum
Assess failure and operational limits of edge cluster architecture and quorum
concepts_covered: Three control-plane servers form a quorum; an odd server count avoids a tie in majority decisions.
The server install script configures a first K3s server; the join script adds another server using the shared token and server URL. The config file sets cluster-level K3s options.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
